# Gaurav Sharma — Filmmaker

> Narrative shorts, brand films and animation by Gaurav Sharma.

## Services

- Narrative short: A story with a beginning and an end, usually one to five minutes.
- Brand film: A film for a product or a company that is watchable on its own.
- Animation: Moving image work that is not shot — sequences, titles, transitions, whole pieces.
